title: picker min width 2x height
rule: Minimum width 2× field-button height — quiet pickers have no minimum; width follows text.
pass_when: Non-quiet picker width is at least 2× field-button height. Quiet picker width follows text (no minimum).
fail_when: Non-quiet picker narrower than 2× height, or a quiet-picker minimum invented in-house.
overview: Non-quiet pickers stay at least twice as wide as the field-button height.
apply_when: Sizing standard Spectrum pickers for usable hit targets and readable values.
not_when: Quiet pickers, whose width follows text with no minimum.
agent_hint: Keep non-quiet pickers ≥2× field-button height; let quiet width follow text.
description: Spectrum sets a minimum width of twice the field-button height for non-quiet pickers so the control remains hittable and the value stays readable. Quiet pickers have no minimum and let width follow the text. Do not invent an in-house minimum for quiet variants, and do not shrink a standard picker below that 2× height ratio. Use this when sizing pickers in forms and action rows; skip it for quiet text-following layouts.
